summary: Website for NewGate Concrete Coating - a business specializing in polyaspartic coating services for patios, driveways, pools, and garages
architectural_notes: Website project for service business (not a web application)

Review system requires backend (Motoko canister) for persistent storage and public display of customer testimonials
